provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench held-out evaluation fixture, authored 2026-10-24 before any training data. Final-model evaluation only; never shown to training-data generation.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt: Repair snippets/breadcrumb-trail.liquid. crumbs is an ordered array of objects with title and url strings. When it is empty output nothing. Otherwise output nav aria-label=Breadcrumb containing one ol with one li per crumb in order. Every li except the last contains one a with href equal to url and text title; the last li contains one span aria-current=page with text title and no link. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/breadcrumb-trail.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
